architecture.title: lexinet current architecture
architecture.description: Single-binary lexinet deployment: agent-friendly CLI and HTTP service backed by an idea-centric Postgres model, relationship graph, and search index.

nodes.title: Agent CLI
nodes.label: Agent CLI
nodes.description: Cobra JSON-first CLI used by agents and operators for idea/name/body/link/traverse/search workflows.

nodes.title: HTTP service :17892
nodes.label: HTTP service :17892
nodes.description: chi HTTP API served by the same lexinet binary on port 17892; health/version are public and mutations are bearer-protected when configured.

nodes.title: Postgres lexinet DB
nodes.label: Postgres lexinet DB
nodes.description: Postgres database with embedded migrations, pgx access, pgcrypto/citext/pg_trgm extensions, and application tables.

nodes.title: Idea/name/body model
nodes.label: Idea/name/body model
nodes.description: Idea-centric schema: one concept has many names plus definitions, examples, and notes.

nodes.title: Relationship graph
nodes.label: Relationship graph
nodes.description: Typed directed idea relationships with reverse labels, symmetric canonicalization, and bounded traversal.

nodes.title: Search index
nodes.label: Search index
nodes.description: Search documents and indexes for exact, prefix, full-text, and opt-in trigram fuzzy search across names and body text.
